scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run build:compile && npm run start
scripts.build:compile: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.ci:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npx --yes concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
